The '''Pella system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector's]] [[Mecetti Province]], on a spur off the [[Procopian Shipping Lane]]; it could be accessed from either the [[Javis system/Legends|Javis system]] or the [[Tumus system/Legends|Tumus system]].
